risk_note: RV2 admin + settlement read (B1-34q; BR-TEXT-21, BR-FUND-18, BR-CALC-02, BR-FUND-01; D10-1401, D10-1403, D10-1464, D10-1494). Workbench 「昨日汇总」: migration 0141 (renamed from 0140, which went to CT-13e, D10-1494) adds app.admin_dashboard_days (PK app_id + stat_date; links, orders, est_rebate_fen, new_users ≥ 0; as_of; grants in the same migration) and indexes orders(app_id, paid_at), users(app_id, created_at), link_logs(app_id, created_at) (plain CREATE INDEX in the migration transaction as 0132; lock_timeout 5 s, statement_timeout 5 min; the header states the write lock on the three tables while building). aggregateDashboardDay reads the four numbers in one REPEATABLE READ read-only snapshot, as_of taken at the snapshot (money r1 S0), through the new exports of linking / orders / identity and settlement's estimatedForPaidRange (the wallet's own pricing: settle commission if not null else estimate, open rights deductions first, reserve_bp and Taolijin deduction, per-beneficiary floor, forfeited shares excluded; selection ESTIMATED and platform_status ≠ DEPOSIT_PAID, D10-1403 Q1). The worker tick (60 s) fills missing due days (D due at D+1 00:10 +08:00, last 7) with INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (money r1 S1); explicit re-aggregation overwrites. readDashboardYesterday returns the newest row not later than yesterday, or null. Lag gauge couli_admin_dashboard_day_lag_days (worker, per app with an admin account; 7 when no row) and alert CouliAdminDashboardDayLag (> 0 for 50m; see plan §3). Commits reordered (as D10-1482): the five test(spec) commits first, then the four implementation commits; final tree identical to the reviewed head. The comment in test/spec/admin/dashboard-yesterday/kit.ts still says 0140 (left as is: the rule test is committed).

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh, reasoning effort medium. r1 (base the branch point) fail: S0 the four numbers and as_of not one snapshot; S1 two workers' ticks overwrite a written row. Both fixed in the r3 implementation (one REPEATABLE READ read-only transaction shared by the four sources, as_of at the snapshot; tick INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, explicit re-aggregation overwrites). r2 (increment from the lag-gauge commit) pass, no findings.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by a fresh independent Claude (in-session Opus subagent of the desktop lane, D10-1448; the first run on the terminal account was cut by 403 and not counted). Codex spec-test r1 fail, 3 S1 (floor vs round invisible; settle_commission_fen = 0 must not fall back to the estimate; negative commission / Taolijin deduction above the base must give 0) → second write #18–#20; r2 pass. Lag gauge tests #21–#23 (D10-1464 ①): r3 (increment) pass. The two frozen alert tests (ledger #34): r4 (increment 992f1f1cd..56e1848fb) pass, confirming the modify_existing of [AC-B1-01zzo#10] (only the couli-admin group and rule appended) and both red_exempt rows of [AC-B1-25b#8] with red_exempt_outside (only collectDashboardDayLag added to the registry fixture outside the test bodies). The kit.ts change to a dynamic import of the test database (depcruise testcontainers-only-in-int-tests) is mechanical and not counted.
